format: Domino's Pizza Traditional Store (leased delivery and carry-out store)

invest.quote: The total investment ranges from $231,450 to $743,500 for a Domino's Pizza Traditional Store ... We estimate the payments made to us and our affiliates together with Initial Fee payments will range from $117,950 to $196,500 for a Domino's Pizza Traditional Store

fee.quote: you will pay an initial franchise application processing fee ("Initial Fee") ranging from $0 to $10,000. ... (1) If you are constructing a Store you will pay an Initial Fee of up to $10,000.
fee.note: May be waived in whole or part under incentive programs; generally not billed until the Store is operating. Training fee up to $1,250. Reservation fee of $25,000 under the new Store build incentive program only if Development Agreement requirements are missed. Purchasing an existing Store: $1,500 transfer fee.

royalty.basis: weekly Royalty Sales (total receipts excluding sales taxes and approved coupons/discounts)
royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 5.5% of Store's weekly Royalty Sales2 Paid via electronic funds transfer by Thursday of each week on royalty sales for the week ending on the preceding Sunday.

adFund.quote: Advertising Fund 4% of Store's weekly Royalty Sales 2, 4 under the Franchise Agreement. ... Advertising Cooperatives 1-4%6
adFund.note: National Advertising Fund 4%. Local/regional cooperatives 1-4%; franchisor may require no less than 2% to the cooperative (or up to 2% local spend if no cooperative). Maximum national + local/regional is 9% of weekly Royalty Sales.

otherRecurring.name: Annual Software Enhancement Fee (Domino's PULSE)
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $819.25 per Store per year, after the first year

otherRecurring.name: Annual Service Fee for Application Processing (SmartRecruiters)
PULSE maintenance, support, third-party licenses and upgrades (estimate)
otherRecurring.amount: should not exceed an average of $7,000 annually

transferFee.amount: $1,500 Before transfer. Payable when Franchise Agreement or the assets of the Store or any ownership interest is transferred.

item19.note: Weekly sales only, no annual figure printed. Includes all U.S. Traditional Stores open the full twelve months (excludes Guam, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands). 2,963 (50%) of franchised stores met or exceeded AWUS in 2025. EBITDA tables from P&Ls of 6,571 franchised stores, include Supply Chain Profit Sharing and Volume Discount rebates; total variable costs include royalty and advertising.

units.quote: Traditional Franchised ... 2025 6751 6948 +197 Traditional Company-Owned ... 2025 292 262 -30 Total Outlets ... 2025 7043 7210 +167

special: Investment assumes a leased site (no real estate purchase). Most equipment, inventory and supplies are bought from the franchisor's affiliate DPD (Domino's supply chain); EBITDA in Item 19 includes Supply Chain Profit Sharing rebates. Royalty is computed weekly. Required Domino's PULSE POS from affiliate DPL ($4,200 initial license fee; hardware and software $15,000 to $25,000).
issues: Item 19 gives weekly, not annual, sales; headline value is the weekly AWUS. Item 20 counts are Traditional outlets only (plus 26 franchised Non-Traditional outlets in 2025). Item 19 EBITDA section says 6,896 franchised stores at end of 2025, differing from Item 20 (6,948 Traditional + 26 Non-Traditional).
